items.description: Bookafy is an online scheduling and appointment tracking web app. This mashup makes use of the Zendesk Core API for ticket tracking and management.
Call In Studio is a call-in platform designed for internet and radio show producers. Allows producers to accept, manage and screen calls for shows in an easy-to-use web- based interface.
Campus map development video by ThinkWrap.

The NCAA partnered with DonorsChoose.org for the NCAA's Fund the Future campaign (www.ncaa.org/fundthefuture) in support of K-12 school districts around the country. The campaign was supported by public service announcements aired on TV during the NCAA championships of March 2011, including the NCAA Division I Menâ€™s and Womenâ€™s Basketball Championships!

An ongoing caption competition that selects two photos from a group on Flickr every day to receive dozens of funny captions. Also uses D3/node.js and Bing image search to show a collaborative mind map for brainstorming caption ideas.

Using Fly Time Notify, pick a travel date then choose your preferred airlines. When airlines unlock that date for booking, you get notified via email and SMS so you can book first. Lock in the best flights and prices or use your frequent flier rewards before everyone else.

Landslide Analytics is an online tool that has a number of algorithms that focus on voter information. With Landslide Analytics, organizations and political campaigns will be able to understand, and will be able to reach out to their audience/voters better.
STEL Order is an invoicing web application that provides businesses a way to securely synchronize their data on the cloud. This application uses Fakturoid API.
Map of hotels in Dublin.

oGoWoo is a free word of mouth advertising system. The system uses the Facebook API for post advertising or promotional messages on users Facebook walls on their behalf, as return they get gifts and discounts.
A service for rating tweets and twitters.
Powered by the Google Fusion Tables API, this service visually displays world statistics on a map. Statistics include: Population, GDP, and currency unit.

Event Now! shows Victoria, Australia events using a handy timemap, it also integrates with Google Calendar to let you save your events, invite friends and set sms reminders. Entrant in the App My State government mashup contest.
Send SMS notifications to subscribers when you publish a new post on your Wordpress-powered website. Currently in Beta testing.

Any statement or challenge can make a journey around the world. Google Maps makes this beautifully visible. Anything you come up with can be followed by thousands of people by creating your own viral.

Venmo makes settling up with friends easy and social. It works with just about any phone or through the web. It's completely free to use with your friends, so you can always skip the ATM when you need to settle up on things like meals, rent, bills, drinks, group trips and bingo.
Scovry is a web discovery site that gets data from multiple popular social sources. This data is shown in an easy to follow streaming ticker format.
Compares over 65,000 hotels, apartments, bed and breakfasts and guest houses across Europe. Now your site can too with this hotel search widget. Widget also uses the sletoh.com hotel comparison API.

CuteOn.Me is a simple app to solicit shopping advice from your friends. It demonstrates how a real-world application can use awe.sm's batch link creation, metadata association, redirection patterns, conversion tracking, and advanced stats retrieval. Documentation and source available.

TripsQ turns airport checkins into various travel statistics. Foursquare can users sign in to tripsQ to visualize trips and travel itineraries. Provides users with detailed statistics on distance traveled, amount of CO² produced during each trip and other information.
This website helps Toronto drivers to locate free parking locations in downtown and beyond.
